about: Keshav's own verdicts on the 12 finalists (version 2), given 1 Nov 2026 from finalists-board.jpg. Recorded as given; no reasons were added beyond what he selected.

rejected_category.as_offered: Odd Works, Nothin', Teenage Engineering's jokes.
rejected_category.tension: He also loved Nothin' and Odd Works. The most consistent reading is that he likes their graphic and typographic form but not playfulness as a tone. Teenage Engineering, whose appeal is a deadpan joke, was not chosen. This is an interpretation and should be confirmed, not assumed.

pattern_observed_by_claude: All six loved sites sit on a light ground: white, pale grey or pale lavender.
All six are led by type, drawing or graphic form rather than by a 3D world or photography.
None of the dark or cinematic picks (Teenage Engineering, Kenta Toshikura, Igloo, Henry Heffernan, Radio Garden's saturated blue) was chosen.
OXMAN is the exception: light and premium, but not chosen. It is the most corporate-institutional of the twelve.
The two loved sites with motion (Immersive Garden and Nothin') both use a single sculptural element reacting to the cursor on a quiet page.
